goal: Report internal disk I/O errors and index corruption explicitly instead of claiming transactions are missing
Distinguish pruned or still-downloading blocks from missing transactions in RPC and REST endpoints
agreement: Substantive support for separating missing transactions from internal read failures (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Addressed concern that queries for pruned blocks returned an I/O error instead of unavailable (yuvicc)
Confirmed immediate error reporting on corruption is desired and added release notes (enirox001)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it prevents silent incorrect lookups when index reads fail from corruption or disk errors
Callers are alerted to underlying index corruption instead of treating existing data as nonexistent

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because RPC and REST callers receive explicit errors rather than false transaction-not-found results
Endpoints clearly distinguish between pruned or downloading blocks and genuinely missing transactions
